banner.title: graphite-exporter
banner.tagline: Takes Graphite plaintext from TrueNAS on TCP and UDP 2003, maps it to labelled Prometheus series, and serves them on 9108.

explainer.title: Graphite lines in, labelled Prometheus series out

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: A LoadBalancer Service exposes TCP and UDP 2003. TrueNAS sends Graphite plaintext to that address.
steps.scene: a cable seated in a network port

steps.title: Map
steps.text: graphite_mapping.conf turns truenas.<host>.<metric> names into one metric name with job, instance and kind labels.
steps.scene: a dotted name splitting into labelled tags

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Two replicas run behind the Service. Each mounts the same mapping from a ConfigMap and serves metrics on 9108.
steps.scene: two identical server racks side by side

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: A ServiceMonitor scrapes port 9108 every minute. honorLabels keeps the job and instance labels from the mapping.
steps.scene: a meter reading a stream of samples

art.about: how Graphite plaintext becomes labelled Prometheus series
art.title: How graphite-exporter maps metrics
